title: Mars Bar from 1991 found – and it's 20g bigger than today's
summary: A 1991 Mars Bar was discovered unopened and found to be 20g larger than today's standard size, serving as an interesting artifact of how product portions have shrunk over three decades.
problem_solved: Not applicable - this is a consumer news article about product size changes rather than a technical solution.
why_valuable: Provides nostalgic insight into how confectionery product sizing has changed over time, reflecting broader trends in 'shrinkflation' and consumer awareness.
